biggest_catch: iVueit states payout timing in its official help center, but no official per-Vue payout amount could be located — amounts only appear third-party.
catches: Official Zendesk: allow up to 2 business days for review (+24–48h more for specialized review); wallet withdrawal paid via PayPal within 24 hours.
Per-Vue pay ($7–$50) is reported only by third-party reviewers, not ivueit.com terms.
Approval-dependent: rejected Vues are not paid.

c2.evidence: No official per-Vue payout amount — third-party only. Same pattern as Favor/Veho/Dispatch: in-app shown amount without official public task payout.

c4.evidence: Official bounded: up to 2 business days review (plus 24–48h for specialized review), PayPal within 24 hours of withdrawal.
